tailoring.headline: SAP Pricing Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud & Pricing Engine Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, micro-services and REST/OCC APIs, with hands-on experience building pricing and promotions engines, integrating PIM, ERP and MDM data pipelines, and deploying cloud-native applications via CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes. Proven techno-functional consultant translating business requirements into robust e-commerce platforms and supporting production at scale.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Pricing Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Pricefx’s innovative cloud pricing platform and its deep SAP integration. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built pricing engines, integrated ERP data, and delivered scalable e-commerce solutions that align perfectly with your vision.

bullets.label: Pricing Engine Expertise
bullets.text: Developed and maintained promotions and pricing engines on SAP Commerce Cloud, delivering rule-based price calculations and discount logic for global B2B/B2C catalogs.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring accurate product and price data across SAP ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: API & Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST APIs for headless commerce and third-party consumption, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker/Kubernetes.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather pricing requirements, authored user stories and functional specs, and delivered solutions that aligned with SAP BTP integration patterns.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Pricefx stands at the forefront of cloud-native pricing, combining SAP-backed reliability with modern BTP integration. I am eager to apply my deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, especially in pricing engine development and ERP-MDM data synchronization, to help Pricefx accelerate its customers’ price-to-market strategies and expand its innovative SaaS offering across the SAP ecosystem.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud pricing and integration experience to drive value for Pricefx’s cloud pricing platform and help customers achieve faster, smarter pricing decisions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years building pricing engines and ERP integrations. I’m keen to discuss how I can contribute to Pricefx’s cloud pricing solutions. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Pricing Consultant – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Pricing Consultant role. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience delivering pricing engines and complex integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to Pricefx. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
